content: nixpkgs stable timeline: 25.05 released 2025-05-23, EOL 2025-12-31 (no security updates after, per NixOS 25.11 blog); 25.11 released 2025-11-30, 7-month support until 2026-06-30; 26.05 (Yarara) released 2026-05-30, supported until 2026-12-31 - the only supported stable as of Sep 2026. vim_configurable deprecated alias of vim-full. Any plan pinning nixos-25.05 (PROJECT.md) is outdated; recommend nixos-26.05.
